milestones.label: First scholarship recipients start to be notified
milestones.source_text: The University of Toronto's Pearson page (official) says recipients begin to be notified at the end of January 2027. It lists no interview or finalist-event dates.

milestones.label: All nominees have been notified of their decision
milestones.source_text: Official University of Toronto page: every nominee will have heard the outcome by April 2027.
